releaseNotes:
• Optimization: Screen Cast is now optional (OFF by default on Android 11+) — visual blurring, kissing/bed/explicit scene skip, and new zero-cast subtitle/caption intimate guard run completely without Screen Cast.
• Battery Fix: Skips scanning when screen is OFF/locked or on launchers/settings/dialers/keyboards, checks static screens BEFORE running ONNX neural nets, runs NudeNet tiling adaptively, and gates audio YAMNet strictly on active media playback.
• Accuracy Fix: Tightened kissing proximity + removed standalone close-up face SFW triggers to prevent false-positive skips.
